_comment: OnDevice-Tiny. Encoder is BERT-Small from Turc et al. 'Well-Read Students Learn Better' (google-research/bert), an existing pretrained checkpoint — not yet distilled. Verified to exist on HF as of 2026-09-22 (see docs/LAYA_ANALYSIS.md). Param counts are the encoder's published config (4 layers x 512 hidden x 8 heads); head adds a few M more (measured, not estimated, once build_model() is run — see RESEARCH_LOG.md for the first real count).
